import requests
import yaml
from collections import Counter

# Load config
with open(''config.yaml'', ''r'') as f:
    config = yaml.safe_load(f)

# Get token
token_url = ''https://id.barentswatch.no/connect/token''
data = {
    ''client_id'': config[''barentswatch''][''client_id''],
    ''client_secret'': config[''barentswatch''][''client_secret''],
    ''scope'': config[''barentswatch''][''scope''],
    ''grant_type'': ''client_credentials''
}

response = requests.post(token_url, data=data, timeout=30)
token = response.json()[''access_token'']

# Get vessel data
headers = {''Authorization'': f''Bearer {token}'', ''Accept'': ''application/json''}
url = ''https://live.ais.barentswatch.no/v1/latest/combined''
response = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=30)
vessels = response.json()

print(''🔍 Analyzing vessel types in BarentsWatch API:'')
print(''='' * 50)

# Analyze vessel types in Arctic
vessel_types = []
buoy_examples = []

for vessel in vessels:
    lat = vessel.get(''latitude'', 0)
    if lat >= 65.0:  # Arctic threshold
        vessel_type = vessel.get(''shipType'', 0)
        vessel_types.append(vessel_type)
        
        name = vessel.get(''name'', ''Unknown'').upper()
        if (''BUOY'' in name or ''BOUY'' in name or ''BEACON'' in name or 
            ''BUSINKA'' in name or ''BØYE'' in name):
            buoy_examples.append({
                ''name'': name,
                ''type'': vessel_type,
                ''speed'': vessel.get(''speedOverGround'', 0)
            })

# Count vessel types
type_counts = Counter(vessel_types)
print(''Vessel Type Distribution:'')
for ship_type, count in type_counts.most_common(10):
    print(f''  Type {ship_type:2d}: {count:4d} vessels'')

print(f''\n🎯 Sample buoys and their types:'')
for buoy in buoy_examples[:10]:
    print(f''  {buoy[""name""]:20s} Type: {buoy[""type""]:2d} Speed: {buoy[""speed""]:4.1f}'')

# Check if there''s a consistent pattern for buoys
buoy_types = [b[''type''] for b in buoy_examples]
buoy_type_counts = Counter(buoy_types)
print(f''\nBuoy Type Distribution:'')
for btype, count in buoy_type_counts.items():
    print(f''  Type {btype}: {count} buoys'')
")
